name: Sit-to-stand from a chair
cues: Feet hip-width, sit at the front of the chair.
Lean forward and stand up without using your hands.
Sit down slowly.

name: Bodyweight squat
cues: Feet shoulder-width.
Sit hips back and down, knees follow your toes, chest up.
Stand tall.

name: Pause squat
cues: Squat down and hold 3 seconds at the bottom without relaxing.
Then stand.

name: One-and-a-half squat
cues: Go all the way down, come halfway up, go back down, then stand fully: that is one rep.

name: Dumbbell goblet squat
cues: Hold one dumbbell upright at your chest, elbows down.
Squat between your knees.
Stand tall.

name: Band squat
cues: Stand on the band with the ends at your shoulders.
Squat down and stand up against the band.

name: Glute bridge
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
Squeeze your buttocks and lift hips until knees, hips and shoulders line up.
Lower slowly.

name: Single-leg glute bridge
cues: Like a glute bridge with one foot lifted.
Keep your hips level.

name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift (bodyweight)
cues: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Push your hips back and reach toward the floor as the back leg rises.
Keep your back flat. Touch a wall for balance if you need to.

name: Single-leg hip thrust (shoulders on couch)
cues: Upper back on a sturdy couch or bench edge, one foot on the floor.
Drive hips up and pause at the top.

name: Sliding hamstring curl
cues: Lie on your back, heels on a towel on a smooth floor.
Lift hips, pull heels toward you, then slide them out slowly.

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
cues: Dumbbells in front of your thighs, soft knees.
Push hips back with a flat back until the backs of your legs stretch.
Stand by squeezing your buttocks.

name: Band pull-through
cues: Band anchored low behind you and held between your legs.
Push hips back, then stand tall by squeezing your buttocks.

name: Dumbbell hip thrust
cues: Upper back on the bench, dumbbell on your hips over a folded towel.
Drive hips up and pause at the top.

name: Supported split squat
cues: One hand on a wall or chair, feet a long stride apart.
Lower the back knee toward the floor and push up through the front foot.

name: Split squat
cues: Feet a long stride apart, hands on hips.
Lower the back knee toward the floor and push up through the front foot.

name: Reverse lunge
cues: Step back, lower the back knee toward the floor, then push through the front foot to return.

name: Rear-foot-elevated split squat
cues: Back foot on a chair or couch, front foot well forward.
Lower straight down and push up through the front foot.

name: Skater squat
cues: Stand on one leg and bend the other knee behind you.
Lower until the back knee touches a cushion.
Stand up.

name: Box pistol squat
cues: Stand on one leg in front of a chair, other leg forward.
Sit down slowly and stand up on one leg.

name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
cues: A dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step back, lower the back knee, push through the front foot to return.

name: Dumbbell step-up
cues: Put the whole foot on a sturdy bench or step.
Stand up tall.
Step down slowly.

name: Wall push-up
cues: Hands on the wall at shoulder height, body straight.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest to the wall.
Push away.

name: High incline push-up
cues: Hands on a kitchen counter, body straight from head to heels.
Lower your chest to the edge.
Push away.

name: Knee push-up
cues: Knees on a cushion, body straight from head to knees.
Lower your chest near the floor.
Push up.

name: Low incline push-up (hands about 30 cm up)
cues: Hands on a sturdy step or low box about 30 cm high, body straight.
Lower your chest to the edge, then push away.
This is lower than a chair seat, so it is harder than a knee push-up.

name: Push-up
cues: Hands a bit wider than shoulders, body straight, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Chest near the floor.
Push up.

name: Feet-elevated push-up
cues: Feet on a chair or step, body straight.
Lower your chest near the floor.
Push up.

name: Archer push-up
cues: Hands wide.
Lower toward one hand while the other arm stays nearly straight.
Push up.
Switch sides.

name: Wall push-up on fists
cues: Like a wall push-up but on closed fists with straight wrists.
Kind to sore wrists.

name: Band chest press
cues: Band around your upper back, one end in each hand.
Press both hands forward to straight arms.
Return slowly.

name: Dumbbell floor press
cues: Lie on the floor, knees bent.
Press the dumbbells up from where your upper arms touch the floor.

name: Dumbbell bench press
cues: Lie on the bench, feet on the floor.
Lower the dumbbells to chest level.
Press up.

name: Elevated pike push-up
cues: Hands on a sturdy chair, hips high in an upside-down V.
Bend your elbows to bring your head toward the seat.
Push back up.

name: Pike push-up
cues: Hands on the floor, hips high in an upside-down V.
Lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Push back up.

name: Feet-elevated pike push-up
cues: Feet on a chair, hips high, hands on the floor.
Lower your head toward the floor.
Push back up.

name: Band overhead press
cues: Stand on the band, hands at your shoulders.
Press overhead without leaning back.
Lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell overhead press
cues: Seated or standing with dumbbells at your shoulders.
Press up until your arms are straight, ribs down.
Lower slowly.

name: Prone Y-T raise
cues: Lie face down, forehead on a towel.
Lift your arms in a Y then a T by squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.

name: Table row (inverted row), knees bent
cues: Only under a very sturdy table: lie under the edge and grip it, knees bent, heels down.
Pull your chest to the table, body straight.
Before every set, lean your full weight on the table edge.
If it tips, slides or wobbles, stop and do a band row or Y-T raise instead.

name: Table row (inverted row), legs straight
cues: Like the bent-knee table row, but with legs straight: body in one line.
Before every set, lean your full weight on the table edge.
If it tips, slides or wobbles, stop and do a band row or Y-T raise instead.

name: Table row (inverted row), feet raised
cues: Like the straight-leg table row, with your heels on a chair.
Before every set, lean your full weight on the table edge.
If it tips, slides or wobbles, stop and do a band row or Y-T raise instead.

name: One-arm dumbbell row
cues: One hand and knee on a bench or chair, back flat.
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip.
Lower slowly.

name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
cues: Lie chest-down on an inclined bench.
Row both dumbbells to your lower ribs.
Lower slowly.

name: Band row
cues: Band anchored in a door at chest height (or sit with legs straight and the band around your feet).
Pull elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.

name: Band pull-apart
cues: Hold a band at shoulder height with straight arms.
Pull it apart until it touches your chest.
Return slowly.

name: Dead hang
cues: Hang from the bar with straight arms and shoulders active, not shrugged to your ears.
Step down, don't drop.

name: Scapular pull-up
cues: From a dead hang, pull your shoulder blades down and back so your body rises a little.
Arms stay straight.

name: Flexed-arm hang
cues: Step up so your chin is over the bar and hold there with elbows bent.
Step down.

name: Negative pull-up
cues: Step up to chin over the bar, then lower yourself slowly over 3-5 seconds to straight arms.
Step back up for the next rep.

name: Band-assisted pull-up
cues: Loop a band over the bar and under one knee or foot.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower with control.
Use a lighter band over time.

name: Chin-up
cues: Palms facing you, shoulder-width.
Pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower all the way.

name: Pull-up
cues: Palms facing away, a little wider than shoulders.
Pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower all the way.

name: Weighted pull-up
cues: Wear a dip belt, or a backpack with a dumbbell packed tight.
Same as a pull-up.
Add weight in small steps.

name: Floor lat pull
cues: Lie face down with arms overhead just off the floor.
Pull your elbows down to your ribs as if doing a pull-up.
Squeeze and return.

name: Band lat pulldown
cues: Band anchored high in a door or over a pull-up bar.
Sit on a chair or kneel and pull your hands down to your chest, elbows to your sides.

name: Dead bug
cues: Lie on your back, arms up, knees over hips.
Slowly lower one arm and the opposite leg while your lower back stays on the floor.

name: Knee plank
cues: Forearms and knees on the floor, body straight from head to knees.
Breathe normally.

name: Plank
cues: Forearms and toes on the floor, body straight, buttocks squeezed.
Breathe normally.

name: Hollow body hold
cues: Lie on your back, lower back pressed down.
Lift shoulders and legs a little off the floor.
Bend knees to make it easier.

name: Body saw
cues: Forearm plank with feet on a towel on a smooth floor.
Slide your body back and forward a little without sagging.

name: Side plank on knees
cues: On one forearm with knees bent, lift your hips so your body is straight from head to knees.

name: Side plank
cues: On one forearm with legs straight, lift your hips so your body is straight from head to feet.

name: Bird dog
cues: On hands and knees, reach one arm and the opposite leg long.
Hold 2 seconds without twisting.
Switch.

name: Band Pallof press
cues: Band anchored at chest height to your side.
Press your hands straight out and resist the twist.
Bring them back.

name: Suitcase carry
cues: Hold one heavy dumbbell at your side.
Walk tall without leaning for the set time.
Switch hands.

name: Band biceps curl
cues: Stand on the band.
Elbows by your sides.
Curl your hands to your shoulders.
Lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell biceps curl
cues: Elbows by your sides.
Curl the dumbbells up without swinging.
Lower slowly.

name: Band triceps pushdown
cues: Band anchored high.
Elbows pinned to your sides.
Push your hands down to straight arms.
Return slowly.

name: Dumbbell overhead triceps extension
cues: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Lower it behind your head by bending the elbows.
Straighten.

name: Chair dip
cues: Hands on the edge of a sturdy chair behind you, knees bent.
Lower until elbows are about 90 degrees.
Push up.

name: High wall sit
cues: Back flat against a wall, feet a step forward and hip-width.
Slide down only a little, to a height that feels easy on your knees.
Hold and breathe.
Slide back up.

name: Supported split-squat hold
cues: One hand on a wall or chair, feet a long stride apart.
Bend both knees only a little and hold.
Keep the front foot flat.
Switch sides.

name: Door-frame row
cues: Face an open door frame and hold both sides at chest height.
Feet just in front of the frame, lean back a little with straight arms.
Pull your chest to the frame, then lower slowly. Step your feet back to make it easier.

name: Wall hip hinge
cues: Stand a foot-length in front of a wall, soft knees.
Push your hips back until your buttocks touch the wall, back flat.
Stand tall by squeezing your buttocks.

name: Supported single-leg Romanian deadlift
cues: One hand on a chair back or counter.
Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Push your hips back and lean forward while the other leg rises behind you.
Flat back.
Stand tall.

name: Standing wall plank
cues: Forearms on a wall at shoulder height, feet stepped back, body straight from head to heels.
Breathe normally.

name: Counter plank
cues: Forearms on a sturdy kitchen counter or table edge, feet stepped back, body straight from head to heels.
Breathe normally.

name: Tandem stance at a counter
cues: Stand next to a kitchen counter, one foot directly in front of the other (heel to toe).
Hands hover over the counter.
Touch it whenever you need.
Switch feet halfway.

name: Single-leg stand at a counter
cues: Stand next to a kitchen counter on one leg, hands hovering over it.
Touch it whenever you need.
Switch legs.

name: Single-leg stand with a slow reach
cues: Next to a kitchen counter, stand on one leg and slowly reach the free hand forward, then to the side.
Touch the counter whenever you need.
Switch legs.

name: Heel-to-toe walk along a counter
cues: Walk slowly along a kitchen counter, putting the heel of one foot right in front of the toes of the other.
One hand hovers over the counter.
Turn and walk back.

name: Step-up onto a low step
cues: Use a stair or sturdy step about shin height, with a wall or rail in reach.
Put your whole foot on the step and push through that heel to stand tall.
Step down slowly.

name: Step-up onto a knee-high step
cues: Use a sturdy step or bench about knee height, never a chair that can tip.
Lean forward a little and drive through the heel on the step to stand tall.
Lower slowly, without pushing off the back foot.

name: Standing hip abduction at a counter
cues: Stand tall holding a counter.
Keep your toes pointing forward and lift one leg out to the side without leaning, then lower it slowly.

name: Side-lying hip abduction
cues: Lie on your side, head on your arm, bottom knee bent.
Keep the top leg straight and in line with your body, toes forward.
Lift it to just above hip height, then lower slowly.

name: Band seated hip abduction
cues: Sit at the front of a chair with a loop band just above your knees.
Push your knees out against the band, hold a moment, then let them come back slowly.
